prompt.en: In most provinces, what is the trial court sometimes called?
prompt.fr: Dans la plupart des provinces, comment appelle-t-on parfois le tribunal de première instance?

options.en: The Supreme Court of the province.
options.fr: La Cour suprême de la province.

options.en: The Court of Appeal of the province.
options.fr: La Cour d'appel de la province.

explanation.en: In most provinces, trials are heard in one court and appeals in another. The trial court is sometimes called the Supreme Court of the province. It is not the same court as the Supreme Court of Canada, which is the highest court in the country.
explanation.fr: Dans la plupart des provinces, les procès sont entendus par un tribunal et les appels, par un autre. Le tribunal de première instance s'appelle parfois la Cour suprême de la province. Ce n'est pas le même tribunal que la Cour suprême du Canada, qui est le plus haut tribunal du pays.

source.quote: In most provinces there is an appeal court and a trial court, sometimes called the Court of Queen’s Bench or the Supreme Court.

verification.evidence: The Supreme Court of Canada is our country’s highest court. The Federal Court of Canada deals with matters concerning the federal government. In most provinces there is an appeal court and a trial court, sometimes called the Court of Queen’s Bench or the Supreme Court.
